scope: public pinned native builtin registration; no private source values
public_register_and_default_alias:
register() ->
    register(default_alias()).
register(Alias) ->
    Module = mnesia_rocksdb,
    case mnesia:add_backend_type(Alias, Module) of
        {atomic, ok} ->
            {ok, Alias};
        {aborted, {backend_type_already_exists, _}} ->
            {ok, Alias};
        {aborted, Reason} ->
            {error, Reason}
    end.
default_alias() ->
    rocksdb_copies.
null_backend_public_default_registration: register/0 moves atom null_copies then calls register/1; register/1 calls mnesia:add_backend_type(null_copies,mria_mnesia_null_storage); init_backend/0 and add_aliases/1 return ok
allowed_sets: unique subsets of the two exact builtin pairs; no other aliases/providers
